{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically below true prices, showing 0.5-2.0 euro lag behind current levels",
    "When sentiment is positive (>=0.67), model under-forecasts more severely by 1-3 euros",
    "Mean reversion is missing from model - it continues trending when prices should be reversing",
    "Sentiment turning negative has little effect on model forecasts, lacking reactionary lag",
    "Volatility contraction isn't captured - model maintains wider spreads than reality",
    "When sentiment flips from positive to negative, model delays by 3-5 forecast steps",
    "Model fails to incorporate the deceleration effect when sentiment score drops below 0.33"
] }
